title: Royal Ukrainian Babka Potatoes
description: A unique twist on traditional babka, incorporating Ukrainian flavors and featuring potatoes as the main ingredient.
instructions: Peel and dice the royal potatoes into 1-inch cubes.
In a large bowl, combine the diced potatoes, jersey butter, floral salt, and 1 tablespoon of chopped parsley. Mix well.
Slice the ukrainian babka into thick slices and toast until lightly browned.
In a separate bowl, mix the aerated sugar and the remaining 1 tablespoon of chopped parsley.
Place the toasted babka slices on a baking sheet and top with the potato mixture.
Drizzle the sugar and parsley mixture over the top of the potatoes.
Bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender and the top is golden brown.
